newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Banco de Credito plans Centam expansion.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Banco de Credito plans Centam expansion.

text.p: Banco de Credito, Peru's leading bank, plans to expand into Central America by opening a branch in Guatemala or El Salvador, bank president Dionisio Romero said Wednesday.
"We are thinking of (opening a branch in) Central America -- in either Guatemala or El Salvador because they are countries about the same size as ours," Romero told reporters.
He said the company also hoped to enter into the neighboring market of Chile, despite being turned down for a license there last year.
Banco de Credito has a branch in New York and offices in Bogota, Santiago de Chile and Buenos Aires.
Banco de Credito is 90.1 percent-owned by Credicorp Ltd.
